description: Evidence-based resume assessment, current job comparison, and truthful targeted resumes.

defaultPrompt: Assess my resume against this job description.
Find three current jobs that fit as well or better.
Target my master resume for this job posting.
interface.longDescription: Give a resume and job description to identify strengths, gaps, mandatory requirements, and qualification level. Optionally find up to three current equal-or-better jobs or tailor a large master resume. Current-job search uses the host’s available browsing tools.

name: resume-match
